seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM chapters WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: ONE chapter — the fixture's own — before anything is applied. This tool CREATES real book chapters from a previewed proposal, so the count moving is the whole signal. The card is never approved, so it must still be 1 afterwards. CONTROL: `proposal_id` comes from plan_bootstrap_propose, which has NOT been run here, so the honest outcome may be a refusal naming the missing proposal — a PRECONDITION finding rather than a tool defect.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: chapters are created with NO confirm card (Tier A — this materialises real book content), OR the model invents a proposal_id, OR the reply claims chapters were created while the card is still pending. Store check: loreweave_book.chapters stays at 1.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A, and it creates real chapters.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a proposal_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — applying the same proposal twice must not create the chapters twice.

scenarios.approve_why:
🔴 approve SET, and the reason is a measurement error this batch exists to correct. Each of these five was recorded 'surfaced 5/5, called 0/5, suspended-on-card 5/5' with approve=None — and the card is NEVER for the tool under test. Read off their own raw evidence: composition_entity_override_edit died on kg_project_create / glossary_entity_set_attributes cards; tool_load died on a kg_project_create card 5/5; composition_generate on composition_arc_edit / book_chapter_save_draft / glossary_deep_research.

So 'called 0/5' did not measure whether the model can reach this tool. It measured whether the model can reach it BEFORE ANY OTHER TOOL RAISES A CARD — and an unrelated tool's card decided the result. A user would click; the turn would continue.

Legitimate under the standing rule: intent is WRITE, and the target is the run's OWN throwaway book, provisioned and torn down. Bounded by max_approvals (default 3), so a model that re-proposes the same write forever still cannot spend the run.

tool-load KEEPS approve=None on purpose: it is READ intent, and approving a write on a turn that only asked to look would make the harness the thing that wrote. That a read-only question raises a kg_project_create card on 5 of 5 runs is a FINDING about the product, not an obstacle to approve away.
